I'm on a spot-price electricity contract. Please schedule these appliance cycles for 2024-02-23 so that my electricity cost is as low as possible, without exceeding my household peak load limit:
- dishwasher (dishwasher_1): ready from 10:45, must finish by 22:00
- washing machine (washing_machine_1): ready from 07:30, must finish by 16:30

results.label: Multi-Agent Pipeline
results.message: Your appliances are scheduled to run at the same time for optimal efficiency! The dishwasher will start at 15:15 and finish by 16:00, while the washing machine will also begin at 15:15 and complete its cycle by 16:30. This schedule keeps your estimated electricity cost low, and your peak load remains well within your household limit. Enjoy your clean dishes and laundry!
